n1ql_active_requests.notes: This metric was named query_active_requests in versions before 7.0.0.

n1ql_allocated_values.help: The total number of values allocated in the query engine.

n1ql_at_plus.help: Total number of N1QL requests with at_plus index consistency.

n1ql_audit_actions.help: The total number of audit records sent to the server. Some requests cause more than one audit record to be emitted. Records in the output queue that have not yet been sent to the server are not counted.

n1ql_audit_actions_failed.help: The total number of audit records sent to the server that failed.

n1ql_audit_requests_filtered.help: The number of potentially auditable requests that cause no audit action to be taken.

n1ql_audit_requests_total.help: The total number of potentially auditable requests sent to the query engine.

n1ql_boot_timestamp_seconds.help: The time the service booted in fractional seconds since Unix epoch.
n1ql_boot_timestamp_seconds.notes: This is a metric specific to serverless.

n1ql_bucket_reads.help: The total number of reads on the bucket.
n1ql_bucket_reads.notes: This is a metric specific to provisioned mode.

n1ql_bucket_retries.help: The total number of retries on the bucket.
n1ql_bucket_retries.notes: This is a metric specific to provisioned mode.

n1ql_bucket_writes.help: The total number of writes on the bucket.
n1ql_bucket_writes.notes: This is a metric specific to provisioned mode.

n1ql_bulk_get_errors.help: Count of errors due to bulk get operations

n1ql_counter_cu_total.help: The number of distinct operations recording Compute Units (CUs) with Regulator.
n1ql_counter_cu_total.notes: This is a metric specific to serverless.

n1ql_credit_cu_total.help: The number of Compute Units (CUs) refunded.
n1ql_credit_cu_total.notes: This is a metric specific to serverless.

n1ql_credit_ru_total.help: The number of Read Units (RUs) refunded.
n1ql_credit_ru_total.notes: This is a metric specific to serverless.

n1ql_credit_wu_total.help: The number of Write Units (WUs) refunded.
n1ql_credit_wu_total.notes: This is a metric specific to serverless.

n1ql_curl_call_errors.help: The number of CURL() calls made by statements that failed (returned an error).

n1ql_curl_calls.help: The number of CURL() calls made by statements.

n1ql_errors.help: The total number of N1QL errors returned so far.
n1ql_errors.notes: In the Couchbase Server UI this metric is computed as a rate, with a display name of "N1QL Error Rate" or n1ql_errors. This metric was named query_errors in versions before 7.0.0.

n1ql_ffdc_manual.help: The total number of ffdc captures triggered due to manual invocation of ffdc admin api

n1ql_ffdc_memory_rate.help: The total number of ffdc captures triggered due to memory usage rate increasing by 20% of the average memory usage over the past 2 hours

n1ql_ffdc_memory_threshold.help: The total number of ffdc captures triggered due to memory usage exceeding the 80% threshold

n1ql_ffdc_plus_queue_full.help: The total number of ffdc captures triggered due to the plus-request queue being full

n1ql_ffdc_request_queue_full.help: The total number of ffdc captures triggered due to the unbounded-request queue being full

n1ql_ffdc_shutdown.help: The total number of ffdc captures triggered due to shutdown processing exceeding 30 minutes

n1ql_ffdc_sigterm.help: The total number of ffdc captures triggered by a SIGTERM signal
n1ql_ffdc_sigterm.notes: This metric is included for completeness, as a SIGTERM resets all accounting metrics to zero, rendering this metric redundant.

n1ql_ffdc_stalled_queue.help: The total number of ffdc captures triggered due to no requests being processed when the queued requests exceed three times the number of servicers within the last 30 seconds

n1ql_ffdc_total.help: The total number of ffdc occurrences

n1ql_index_hint_not_followed.help: The total number of index hints not followed

n1ql_index_scans.help: Total number of secondary index scans.

n1ql_index_scans_fts.help: Total number of index scans performed by FTS.
n1ql_index_scans_fts.notes: This is a sub-division of n1ql_index_scans.

n1ql_index_scans_gsi.help: Total number of index scans performed by GSI.
n1ql_index_scans_gsi.notes: This is a sub-division of n1ql_index_scans.

n1ql_index_scans_seq.notes: This is a sub-division of n1ql_index_scans.

n1ql_invalid_requests.help: Total number of requests for unsupported endpoints.
n1ql_invalid_requests.notes: In the Couchbase Server UI this metric is computed as a rate, with a display name of "N1QL Invalid Request Rate" or n1ql_invalid_requests. This metric was named query_invalid_requests in versions before 7.0.0.

n1ql_load.help: The current utilization factor of the servicers on the query node.
n1ql_load.notes: This metric is a value ranging from 0 to beyond 100. A value of 0 indicates that there are no servicers that are busy. 100 indicates that all servicers are busy. Greater than 100 indicates that all servicers are busy and there are queued requests.

n1ql_load_factor.help: The total load factor of the query node.
n1ql_load_factor.notes: The load factor is a value from 0 to 100. It is the maximum of 3 values. The Servicer Load, CPU Usage and Memory Usage. It is calculated every 30 seconds and reported as a moving average over the last 15 minutes.

n1ql_mem_quota_exceeded_errors.help: Count of memory quota exceeded errrors

n1ql_meter_cu_total.help: The number of Compute Units (CUs) recorded.
n1ql_meter_cu_total.notes: This is a metric specific to serverless.

n1ql_node_memory.help: The total size of in use memory in the query node.

n1ql_node_rss.help: The resident set size (RSS) of the query node process.

n1ql_op_count_total.help: The number of distinct operations recorded with Regulator.
n1ql_op_count_total.notes: This is a metric specific to serverless.

n1ql_prepared.help: Total number of prepared statements executed.

n1ql_primary_scans.help: Total number of primary index scans.

n1ql_primary_scans_fts.help: Total number of primary scans performed by FTS.
n1ql_primary_scans_fts.notes: This is a sub-division of n1ql_primary_scans.

n1ql_primary_scans_gsi.help: Total number of primary scans performed by GSI.
n1ql_primary_scans_gsi.notes: This is a sub-division of n1ql_primary_scans.

n1ql_primary_scans_seq.help: Total number of primary sequential scans.
n1ql_primary_scans_seq.notes: This is a sub-division of n1ql_primary_scans.

n1ql_queued_requests.notes: This metric was named query_queued_requests in versions before 7.0.0.

n1ql_reject_count_total.help: The number of times Regulator instructed an operation to be rejected.
n1ql_reject_count_total.notes: This is a metric specific to serverless.

n1ql_request_time.help: Total end-to-end time to process all queries.
n1ql_request_time.notes: In the Couchbase Server UI this metric is computed as an average, with a display name of "Query Request Time" or n1ql_avg_req_time. This metric was named query_request_time in versions before 7.0.0.

n1ql_requests.notes: In the Couchbase Server UI this metric is computed as a rate, with a display name of "N1QL Request Rate" or n1ql_requests. This metric was named query_requests in versions before 7.0.0.

n1ql_requests_1000ms.help: Number of queries that take longer than 1000ms.
n1ql_requests_1000ms.notes: This metric was named query_requests_1000ms in versions before 7.0.0.

n1ql_requests_250ms.help: Number of queries that take longer than 250ms.
n1ql_requests_250ms.notes: This metric was named query_requests_250ms in versions before 7.0.0.

n1ql_requests_5000ms.help: Number of queries that take longer than 5000ms.
n1ql_requests_5000ms.notes: This metric was named query_requests_5000ms in versions before 7.0.0.

n1ql_requests_500ms.help: Number of queries that take longer than 500ms.
n1ql_requests_500ms.notes: This metric was named query_requests_500ms in versions before 7.0.0.

n1ql_result_count.help: Total number of results (documents) returned by the query engine.
n1ql_result_count.notes: In the Couchbase Server UI this metric is computed as an average, with a display name of "Query Result Items" or n1ql_avg_result_count. This metric was named query_result_count in versions before 7.0.0.

n1ql_result_size.help: Total size of data returned by the query engine.
n1ql_result_size.notes: In the Couchbase Server UI this metric is computed as an average, with a display name of "Query Result Size" or n1ql_avg_response_size. This metric was named query_result_size in versions before 7.0.0.

n1ql_scan_plus.help: Total number of N1QL requests with request_plus index consistency.

n1ql_selects.notes: In the Couchbase Server UI this metric is computed as a rate, with a display name of "N1QL Select Rate" or n1ql_selects. This metric was named query_selects in versions before 7.0.0.

n1ql_service_time.notes: In the Couchbase Server UI this metric is computed as an average, with a display name of "Query Execution Time" or n1ql_avg_svc_time. This metric was named query_service_time in versions before 7.0.0.

n1ql_temp_space_errors.help: Count of temp space related errors

n1ql_tenant_kv_throttle_count.help: The total number of times KV has been throttled for queries on this tenant.
n1ql_tenant_kv_throttle_count.notes: This is a metric specific to serverless.

n1ql_tenant_kv_throttle_seconds_total.help: The total amount of time KV has been throttled for queries on this tenant.
n1ql_tenant_kv_throttle_seconds_total.notes: This is a metric specific to serverless.

n1ql_tenant_memory.help: The total size of in use tenant memory.
n1ql_tenant_memory.notes: This is a metric specific to serverless.

n1ql_tenant_reads.help: The total number of reads on the tenant.
n1ql_tenant_reads.notes: This is a metric specific to serverless.

n1ql_tenant_retries.help: The total number of retries on the tenant.
n1ql_tenant_retries.notes: This is a metric specific to serverless.

n1ql_tenant_writes.help: The total number of writes on the tenant.
n1ql_tenant_writes.notes: This is a metric specific to serverless.

n1ql_throttle_count_total.help: The number of times Regulator instructed an operation to throttle.
n1ql_throttle_count_total.notes: This is a metric specific to serverless.

n1ql_throttle_seconds_total.help: The total time spent throttling (in seconds).
n1ql_throttle_seconds_total.notes: This is a metric specific to serverless.

n1ql_transaction_time.help: Total elapsed time of transactions so far.

n1ql_unbounded.help: Total number of N1QL requests with not_bounded index consistency.

n1ql_warnings.help: The total number of N1QL warnings returned so far.
n1ql_warnings.notes: In the Couchbase Server UI this metric is computed as a rate, with a display name of "N1QL Warning Rate" or n1ql_warnings. This metric was named query_warnings in versions before 7.0.0.
